verdict.rationale: Grafana's source is public in the grafana/grafana GitHub repository, and community reports confirm Grafana 8+ ships under AGPLv3, which they note is a move from one FOSS license to another. First-party material also references 'Grafana OSS' and an open source MCP server. Missing for 10: first-party documentation stating the license terms, and clarity on which features (e.g. Enterprise-only ones) sit outside the open-source codebase.
